isDisabled:
{{
  !SelectNrNaboru.selectedOptionValue ||
  !SelectRodzaj.selectedOptionValue ||
  !DateZatwierdzenie.selectedDate ||

  [
    InputIleRMR.text,
    InputIleRWS.text,
    InputIleBP.text,
    InputIleRMRrez.text,
    InputIleRWSrez.text,
    InputIleBPrez.text,

    CurrencyRMR.value,
    CurrencyRWS.value,
    CurrencyBP.value,
    CurrencyRMRrez.value,
    CurrencyRWSrez.value,
    CurrencyBPrez.value
  ].some(v =>
    v === null ||
    v === undefined ||
    String(v).trim() === ""
  )
}}
